analytic_identity: For independent v_i~Uniform(-V,V), abs(v_i)~Uniform(0,V), exactly the positive prior. The event depends only on v_i^2/R_i and fixed baryonic order/tie averaging. Hence c_positive=c_symmetric at every common V; for fixed saved Q, Q/c is identical. The Gaussian likelihood is not sign invariant, so this does not equate posterior numerators.
helper_event: strict descending v_i squared / R_i after descending g_bar ordering; arithmetic mean over tie permutations
